这三个参数只影响配套摇杆的连续瞄准，不改变快推 Flick 的目标转角。水平目标: These three settings affect companion stick aiming only, not the target angle of a quick Flick. Horizontal target speed depends on the base rate, aim multiplier and stick progress; vertical speed also uses the vertical ratio.
「满杆角速度」是游戏实际满杆转速的校准值，用于把目标转速换算成虚拟摇杆幅度。提高: Full-stick angular speed calibrates the game's actual maximum turn rate and converts target speed to virtual stick deflection. Increasing the continuous aim base rate cannot increase the game's maximum turn rate.
校准数值超出允许范围: Calibration value is outside the allowed range.
试转时输出时序中断，请重新试转。: Output timing was interrupted. Please retry the turn.
试转需要先保存配置并启用映射输出: Save the profile and start mapping output before trying a turn.
请先启用体感或 Flick，再打开转角校准。: Enable gyro or Flick before opening turn calibration.
手动测量需要启用角速度瞄准，并连接支持体感的手柄。: Manual measurement requires angular-rate aiming and a controller with a gyro.
鼠标转角系数需大于 0 且不超过 10000。: Mouse counts per degree must be greater than 0 and no more than 10000.
请切回游戏，再使用 Ctrl + Shift + F8 试转。: Return to the game, then press Ctrl + Shift + F8 to try a turn.
请观察是否完整转一圈。试转结束后自动停止，再对齐参照物并调整数值。F12 可停止: Watch for exactly one full turn. Output stops automatically. Realign with your landmark and adjust the value. F12 stops mapping. Matching the starting direction may also mean multiple full turns.
对齐参照物后试转: Align with a landmark, then try a turn
没转够 → 调大数值；转过头 → 调小数值。鼠标转角系数表示每度需要的移动量。: Too short → increase the value. Too far → decrease it. The mouse turn scale is the movement required per degree.
没转够 → 调小数值；转过头 → 调大数值。使用摇杆 Flick 前，请将游戏摇: Too short → decrease the value. Too far → increase it. For stick Flick, set a linear in-game stick curve and disable edge and other turn acceleration.
每次重新对齐参照物，确认完整转一圈。修改后再次试转，保存时才写入配置。校准后保持: Realign with the landmark before each trial and check for one complete turn. Edit and retry; values are written only when saved. Keep in-game sensitivity unchanged afterward.
保存并应用基础层配置，启用映射后打开悬浮窗。对准参照物试转 360°，直接调整数: Save and apply the base profile, start mapping, then open the overlay. Align with a landmark, try a 360° turn, edit the value and retry. Save when satisfied. Manual rotation measurement remains under More calibration methods.
使用摇杆 Flick 前，请将游戏摇杆响应曲线设为线性，并关闭边缘及其他转向加速: For stick Flick, set a linear in-game stick curve and disable edge and other turn acceleration. Keep in-game sensitivity unchanged after calibration.
